How do I start a return or an exchange?
No worries, we can walk through it. To start a return:
If you’re in the UK, go to the returns portal, search for “Chillys”, enter your details and choose a return method.
Outside the UK, post your unused item to the returns address shown on your despatch note, using a tracked/signed service.
A couple of key points:
You’ve got 30 days after delivery to return.
Items must be unused and in saleable condition.
Return postage is paid by you (we don’t offer free returns).
Engraved items and individual parts of a bundle can’t be returned – bundles must be sent back complete and unused for a refund.
Exchanges aren’t mentioned in our process, so you’d generally return for a refund, then place a new order for what you’d like instead.
